body: Empty chat cell + Home 'Encrypted message' for one delivered message: the core recognised MLS/legacy-RSA/agent-sealed envelopes in canonical.rs prepare() but left Prepared.envelope=None, so build_snapshot's failure test (envelope.is_some() && payload.is_none()) never fired — the row rendered blank AND unflagged, which is indistinguishable from a genuinely empty message. Fixed: Prepared.sealed_elsewhere, set in that match arm, and DECRYPTION_FAILED inserted only when text+caption+media are all absent (a host-projected plaintext must not be flagged, or decryptFailed inflates with working rows). 20 canonical tests pass incl. 2 new ones.
author: Vibe Team
